text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hussein says peace is key to future of whole Middle East region. Jerusalem is symbol of that peace, towering above question of which side controls it.
- King allows former Hamas politburo chief Mousa Abu Marzook to return to Jordan.
- Israeli tourist stabbed in northern tourist site of Umm Qeis, lightly wounded.
- 129 Jordanians from "Group A" returnees from Gulf War to get compensation in next couple of weeks from U.N. committee.
- European Union offers 150,000 dinar ($212,000) grant to Jordan to encourage women's participation in forthcoming parliamentary elections.
- Head of Jordan Petroleum Refinery calls for liberalisation of fuel prices.
- Jordan accepts nomination of new Israeli envoy.
- King, Israel's Prime Minister Netanyahu optimistic on peace.
